Provincial Councils Notifications
NORTHERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Transfer of Court fines and Penalties Statute No. 01 of 2017 of the Northern Province, Provincial Council

A Statute to provide for the transfer of Fines and Penalties imposed by Courts and collected under the Finance Statute of theNorthern Province Provincial Council No. 01 of 2014 to the Local Authorities in the Northern Province.
Be enacted by the Northern Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A PG 3545 — 27 (06/2017)
Short title1. This Statute may be cited as the Transfer of Court Fines and Penalties Statute of the
Northern Province Provincial Council No. 01 of 2017 and shall come into operation onsuch date as the Governor of the Northern Province may give his assent thereto.
2. Where the Provincial Council has collected, in terms of the Finance Statute of the

Northern Province Provincial Council No. 01 of 2014, the fines and penalties imposedby Courts situated in the Northern Province, the Provincial Council shall transfer theamount of such fines and penalties to the relevant Local Authority on a claim, in writing,by the Chief Administrative Officer of such Local Authority to the Minister in charge ofthe subject of Finance of the Province, made within a period of five years from the thirty-first day of December of the year in which such fines and penalties were collected asaforesaid. Provided that the transfer shall be made within a period of six months from thedate of claim.
3. No claim under Section 2 shall be valid unless accompanied with a schedule of payment

of such fines and penalties specified in the claim specifying the date of such payments,the date of remittance of such amount by the relevant court to the Provincial Council andthe Ordinance or the Act under which such fines and penalties have been imposed withparticular reference to the schedule thereof and certified by the Registrar of the Courtwhich imposed and charged such fines and penalties or any other officer nominated byhim on that behalf.

4. In this Statute, unless the context otherwise requires, “Chief Administrative Officer”
means
(a) In relation to a Municipal Council, the Municipal Commissioner ; and
(b) In relation to an Urban Council or a Pradeshiya Sabha, the Secretary thereof ;

“Local Authority” means any Municipal Council, Urban Council or Pradeshiya Sabha andincludes any authority created and established by or under any law to exercise, performand discharge power, duties and function corresponding to or similar to the powers, dutiesand functions exercised, performed and/or discharged by any such Council or Sabha ;
“Province” means the Northern Province of the Democratic Socialist Republic of SriLanka ;
“Provincial Council” means the Provincial Council of the Northern Province of theDemocratic Socialist of Sri Lanka
5. In the event of any inconsistency between the Tamil, Sinhala and English texts of this
Statute, the Tamil text shall prevail
